rationale.surface_lmax: Frozen before the MNSol-10 run from an independent water comparison against pyddx ddPCM: lmax=5 differed by 1.211143143070581e-5 eV.
rationale.partition_lmax: Twice surface_lmax so every partition mode visible to P_L M_w P_L is represented.
rationale.transition_width_angstrom2: Inherited unchanged from the already frozen harmonic ddCOSMO MNSol profile; it was not selected using harmonic ddPCM panel errors.
rationale.quadrature: The source and partition orders are inherited from the frozen harmonic ddCOSMO profile. The double-layer order was fixed by single-sphere, tangency, and water convergence canaries before this panel run.
rationale.finite_dielectric: Uses the published two-stage ddPCM equation rather than uniform COSMO dielectric scaling.

decision_rule: Run the frozen panel once. Do not adjust lmax, partition bandwidth, transition width, dielectric equation, cavity, CDS, source coefficients, or panel membership after observing its errors. A failure closes this preregistered profile rather than triggering in-panel tuning.
